                                               ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing the M3-3 Heavy Industry District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
5-G in the area bounded by

A line 98.7 feet southwesterly and parallel to West Homer Street; North Mendell Street; A line 200.25 feet
southwesterly and parallel to West Homer Street; the alley ne.xt westerly and parallel to North Mendell
Street



to those of a C3-3 Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property:              1918 N Mendell Street
                  PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS

                    TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT

                           1918 N Mendell Street
The Applicant seeks to rezone from M3-3 Heavy Industry District to a C3-3 Commercial,
Manufacturing and Employment District

The Applicant seeks to adaptively reuse the existing 4-story building and construct a one-story
addition over the surface parkmg lot and add a new sidewalk along the front property line. The
Applicant seeks to utilize the first and second floors of the building with a day care use. The
third and fourth floors will contain general office uses. The property is a TSL due to its
proximity to the Clybourn Metra Station. No parking is required or will be provided. The
height of the building will remain existing at 47' 1.11 / 2 " to the roof.
